reviews.comment: This class was easy but just a lot of work. Each week there was a discussion that you had to reply to others, participation, a quiz, homework, and optional extra credit work. Each thing has 2 attempts so pretty easy to score good grades on, just a lot of work to do, but exams are also open note. She also drops the lowest grade of each category.
Overall an amazing prof! Just a lot of busy work but if you put in the time and effort into all the modules then you can get an easy A.

The best quality Prof. Chrpa has is that she is very organized. Even though you do have to put in the time and effort to get your assignments done in this class, it never felt like it was an unfair amount. As long as you do the participation quizzes and the quizzes, you should have a good idea of what the tests are about. Solid choice.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria
